statement: Paper B Proposition 7.4 (shift average), with the printed constants. Let L >= 1, reals x_t and A_t for 0 <= t < L with |A_t - A_s| >= a |t - s| for some a > 0, and S_lambda = sum_t e(A_t {x_t + lambda}). Then |int_0^1 |S_lambda|^2 dlambda - L| <= (4/pi)(L/a)(1 + log L), and for every eta > 0 the shifts lambda in (0, 1] with |S_lambda| > [(L/eta)(1 + (4/(pi a))(1 + log L))]^{1/2} have measure at most eta. Each off-diagonal term is integrated over the period starting at a breakpoint, where the phase is affine with slope A_t - A_s on two intervals, giving at most 2/(pi |A_t - A_s|); the row sums are at most 2 H_{L-1}. The proposition gives no bound at a prescribed shift.
